name: DescribeErrorLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the mongos node or shard node whose error logs you want to query in the instance. If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, you must specify this parameter.

This parameter is valid only when DBInstanceId is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node whose error logs you want to query in the instance. Valid values:

primary

secondary

If you set the NodeId parameter to the ID of a mongos node, the RoleType parameter must be set to primary
parameters.help_zh:
实例中节点的角色。取值：
primary：主节点。
secondary：从节点。

当NodeId参数传入的是Mongos节点ID时，本参数取值只能为primary
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time and within 24 hours from the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，且与查询开始时间间隔时长不能大于一天。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords used for query. You can enter up to 10 keywords at a time. If you enter multiple keywords, separate the keywords with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between multiple keywords. Valid values:

or

and (default value)
parameters.help_zh: 关键字搜索的逻辑操作， 默认值为and
